description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quick Cast], [Buff Fire 30% (15s)] and [Fated Burn Finisher] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Buff Fire 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Fated Burn Finisher
description.text: Casts Fated Burn when removed, removed if user hasn't Awoken Fire
